test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If the difference between the selling prices of an article when sold at 18% discount and at 10.5% discount is Rs. 192, then the marked price of the article is:
solution:
**Given:**

Discount percentages are 18% and 10.5%

**Concept used:**

SP = MP - MP × Discount%

**Calculation:**

Let marked price be 100x

So,

SP = 100x - 18x = 82x [When Discount = 18%]

SP = 100x - 10.5x = 89.5x [When Discount = 10.5%]

According to the question,

89.5x - 82x = 192

⇒ 7.5x = 192

⇒ 100x = 2560

**∴ The marked price of the article is Rs.2560**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** 18% - 10.5% = 192

⇒ 7.5% = 192

⇒ 1% = 25.6

⇒ Marked price = 100% = 100 × 25.6 = Rs. 2560
